race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Pace
race.comment: BONJORGE (1) put the writing on the wall when she came from a wider barrier for second last start at this circuit and distance. Should be peaking now and is well served by the ace draw. SECRET LINE (9) draws for a trail and has good form on the board, recording a win and a placing from his last two outings here. YANKEE BABE (2) is in good form and is another that draws lower than when she finished third at her latest appearance here. May feature from this barrier.
